text: By default, every visual on a page already talks to every other one. Here's how to see that, and how to change it.
Select a visual, then Format, Edit interactions. That's the switch that turns on a live control panel for how that visual affects everything else on the page.

Every other visual now shows Filter, Highlight, and None icons. Filter narrows what the other visual shows. Highlight dims the rest while keeping it visible. None means no effect at all. One exception: line charts, scatter charts, and maps can only be filtered, never highlighted.

And drilling stays contained to its own visual by default — set Apply drill down filters to Entire page, and drilling updates everything else too. Next: drill down and drill through — moving from a summary straight to the detail behind it.
